entries.reason: Test support for the upload machine: it generates the paths the unit test checks and the paths spec replays. No app code imports it.

The Turnstile widget on the sign-in and sign-up forms. The spec drives it through ready, a refused token, a blocked script and the retry; its logic lives in app/lib/turnstile-client.ts, which has a unit test.
Tagged error classes hold no logic. The test maps each one to its tRPC error, and the tagged-error-mapped rule fails a class with no mapping.
The browser entry point. Every e2e spec hydrates through it; the auth spec fails if forms never hydrate.
The server render entry point. The spec reads the headers and the nonce it puts on every page.
The root layout and error boundary. The spec loads a page and a 404 through it.
The route table. Every page.goto in e2e resolves through it.
A four-line entry over scripts/lint/cli.ts, kept so older briefs still work.
A rule carries its own cases. The self-test runs them and fails a rule that lacks a failing or a passing case.
Case data for the rules. The self-test runs every case and fails one whose expectation is wrong.
Playwright's global setup: it restores the seeded database once per run. The spec signs in as each fixture role and fails when the restore did not run.
